Crosses, halts and the cleaning log of a LOBSTER day

Source: R/clean.R
lobster_metadata.Rd

Accessors for the metadata that lobster_clean() stores with its output (and that lobster_snapshots() and lobster_process() pass on).

Usage

lobster_crosses(x)

lobster_halts(x)

lobster_log(x)

Arguments

x

Output of lobster_clean(), lobster_snapshots() or lobster_process().

Value

  • lobster_crosses(): a data.table with one row per cross message (type 6) of the whole file: ts, time, kind ("opening" for order id -1, "closing" for -2, "other", e.g. halt or IPO crosses), order_id, size (shares), price (USD, NA for a cross without volume) and dollar_volume. None of them is part of the cleaned messages or the snapshots.

  • lobster_halts(): a data.table with one row per halt that overlaps continuous trading: start, end (seconds after midnight), start_time, end_time, resumed (FALSE if trading did not resume before the close) and ended_by ("resumption", "execution" when the first trade after the halt message came before any resumption message, or "close").

  • lobster_log(): a list with message counts: n_raw messages in the file (from first_ts to last_ts), n_outside_session, n_in_halts, n_cross_messages, n_halt_messages, n_kept, n_invalid_book (kept messages after which the book is crossed or one-sided), n_crossed_book, n_trades and n_midpoint_trades, plus the session boundaries and the number of book levels in the file and read.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
msgs <- lobster_clean(message_file, orderbook_file)
lobster_crosses(msgs)
lobster_halts(msgs)
lobster_log(msgs)
} # }
